recipes.name: AVO · community implementation
setup: Prepare Python 3.10+ and the pinned repository dependencies in a separate native environment.
Install the native package only as an explicit operator step.

profiles.description: Community AVO reimplementation: original native agentic variation, lineage and scorer interface.

evaluation.description: Configured native ScoringFunction correctness and per-configuration values; native geometric mean remains implementation-specific.

argument_help: Stage a credential-free YAML config, seed, scorer and optional knowledge base through request.inputs.
Supply provider credentials only through explicit environment_names.
limitations: Independent austin1997 implementation of the AVO paper; not an author-released NVIDIA implementation or a paper reproduction claim.
Native generated-code execution requires worker isolation. Library defaults and scorer semantics remain native.
A full model-driven run and environment have not been verified.

recipes.name: OpenEvolve · independent AlphaEvolve implementation
setup: Prepare Python 3.10+ and install the pinned repository in a separate environment.
Configure an explicit model provider, candidate/evaluator dependencies and a worker sandbox.

profiles.description: OpenEvolve native evolutionary search and Python evaluator.

evaluation.description: Native evaluator loads the supplied evaluate function; objective metrics and optional cascade stages remain defined by that evaluator.

argument_help: Stage the initial program, evaluator and explicit YAML config through request.inputs.
Select models, evaluation timeout and concurrency explicitly in the native config. Output is forced by Arena.
limitations: OpenEvolve is an independent implementation inspired by AlphaEvolve; it is not Google DeepMind's private engine.
The native checkpoint option does not establish Arena lifecycle/resume conformance.
Native environment, model-driven research runs and cross-task conformance remain unverified.
